videos.title: Sounds of the 60s with Tony Blackburn
videos.description: Tony brings you two hours of music from the best decade ever, with hits from Dave Clark Five, Long John Baldry and The Beatles. This week, the top three comes from 1967.

videos.title: Dermot O'Leary
videos.description: Faithful James Blunt joins Dermot to chat about his new Christmas single Another Day. Plus, Romesh may pop in to have a Traitors debrief.

videos.title: Romesh Ranganathan
videos.description: Actor, comedian and writer Daisy May Cooper joins Romesh live in the studio to talk about her debut novel What Took You So Long.

videos.title: Mark Goodier
videos.description: Spend Saturday lunchtime with Mark Goodier. Whether you're out and about or chilling at home, he is standing by to speak to you and hit shuffle on all your favourite music.

videos.title: Rylan on Saturday
videos.description: Sugababes icon Keisha Buchanan joins Rylan to spill the beans on her podcast The Girls Are Talking, revealing what goes on behind the mic, the candid conversations and the gossip.

videos.title: Sounds of the 80s with Gary Davies
videos.description: Featuring a U2 Mastermix and Boy George on Your Top 3. Gary also pays tribute to Duran Duran's Andy Taylor.

videos.title: Sounds of the 90s with Fearne Cotton
videos.description: Fearne's remembering the good, the bad, and the weird from this week in the 90s, all soundtracked by top 90s tunes.

videos.title: Sounds of the 90s with Fearne Cotton
videos.description: An hour of tunes that a teenage Fearne Cotton played on repeat... from the likes of Take That, The Prodigy and Shania Twain.

videos.title: Dance Sounds of the 90s with Vernon Kay
videos.description: An hour of back-to-back rave tracks from The Prodigy, N Joi, Liquid, Xpansions, Awesome 3, Congress, Shut Up and Dance, SL2, Manix and many more.

videos.title: Alternative Sounds of the 90s with Dermot O'Leary
videos.description: Dermot plays the biggest selling alternative albums of the 90s, including Oasis, REM and Moby.

videos.title: CMA Music Festival 2026
videos.description: 3/5. Shelly Fairchild with highlights of the CMA Music Festival 2026 in Nashville including Lainey Wilson, Tim McGraw, Jordan Davis, Carly Pearce, Riley Green, Zach Top and more.

videos.title: Vernon Kay's Christmas Crooners
videos.description: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas! In the happiest Christmas show of all, Vernon Kay opens his Christmas Crooners Cracker full of your festive favourites this holiday season.

videos.title: Radio 2 Unwinds Mix with Angela Griffin
videos.description: De-stress and wind down from your day with a mix of soothing festive music, featuring Olivia Dean, Mariah Carey and Coldplay.

videos.title: Tracks of My Years
videos.description: Peter Gabriel joins Vernon Kay for an in-depth conversation about his life via ten of his favourite songs, as he releases his new album o/i.

videos.title: Good Morning Sunday
videos.description: The Reverend Kate Bottley spreads hope and joy, with uplifting stories about life, love and modern spirituality, alongside a great soundtrack for Sunday morning.

videos.title: Love Songs with Michael Ball
videos.description: Your true stories and favourite love songs with Michael... easy like Sunday morning.

videos.title: Paddy McGuinness
videos.description: Paddy's live from Salford and he needs your submissions for this year's little helpers. Who will make the nice list? Plus, The Weekest Link quiz the Serene 15, and Paddy's Timewarp.

videos.title: Elaine Paige on Sunday
videos.description: Elaine's got lots and lots of show tunes and movie songs, plus the latest stage and screen news, her Winter Warmer Double Bill, your requests, and your Pantomime Break a Legs.

videos.title: Sounds of the 70s with Shaun Keaveny
videos.description: The 'Bard of Salford', punk poet John Cooper Clarke is Shaun's 'My 70s' guest.

videos.title: Pick of the Pops
videos.description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1987.

videos.title: Pick of the Pops
videos.description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1994.

videos.title: Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour
videos.description: Tony Blackburn spins his personal pick of the hits from across the decades. To listen on most smart speakers just 'ask BBC Sounds to play Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour'.

videos.title: The Paul Gambaccini Collection
videos.description: Paul picks his favourite songs from every year - starting in 1958, working his way to 1982. So expect some Elton, Bobby Darin, Eagles, Ray Charles and Irene Cara.

videos.title: Radio 2 Unwinds with Angela Griffin
videos.description: Angela Griffin shares a selection of calming tunes for a cosy night in.

videos.title: Radio 2 Unwinds Mix with Angela Griffin
videos.description: Angela Griffin has a playlist perfect for late-night listening, featuring Brenda Russell, Janet Jackson, Sam Smith and many more.

videos.title: Richie Anderson
videos.description: Richie Anderson is live from Salford with your Monday Motivation to kick-start a brand new week, plus Secret Star and This Week in Songs.

videos.title: Tony Blackburn's Sounds of Soul
videos.description: Tony's back for a wonderful show focusing on love-filled soul tunes and classics. Including music from Barry White, Nicole Henry, Leon Bridges, Dionne Warwick and Lou Rawls.

videos.title: Owain Wyn Evans
videos.description: Welcome! It's Early Breakfast with Owain Wyn Evans, featuring Airdrum Anthems. What advice would you give your younger self.

videos.title: The Sara Cox Breakfast Show
videos.description: It's all 80s with Aidan Turner and Katherine Parkinson in the studio. Plus, Heigh Ho.

videos.title: Vernon Kay
videos.description: Legendary musician Peter Gabriel picks his Tracks Of My Years this week, starting with songs by Nina Simone and Otis Redding.

videos.title: Jeremy Vine
videos.description: Jeremy and guests discuss the news headlines and talk to the people making them.

videos.title: Trevor Nelson
videos.description: Trevor brings you some of the best music from across the decades to get you through the afternoon.

videos.title: Angela Scanlon
videos.description: The official end of the day is here! If you're on the way home, wrangling the kids or working out what to have for tea... Angela's got the soundtrack and wants to hear about your day.

videos.title: Jo Whiley
videos.description: Bono and The Edge join Jo for a conversation about their 50-year career ahead of a special one-off concert recorded live at the Tate Modern in London.

videos.title: Jo Whiley
videos.description: Jo Whiley brings you a special live performance from U2 recorded exclusively for the BBC. Featuring tracks 'With or Without You' ,'Pride' and 'The Greatest Show on Earth'.

videos.title: The Blues Show with Cerys Matthews
videos.description: Cerys's weekly round-up of the blues you need to hear, from all around the world and in all shapes and sizes.

videos.title: The Good Groove with DJ Spoony
videos.description: Feelgood tunes to groove and soothe your soul. Dr Beat is also on hand to prescribe a perfect tune for a listener whose week hasn't got off to the best start.
